query: What can members do if the funds in which they have already invested do not meet the new standards set by the Board following re-evaluation?
reference_answer: Members who have already invested in such funds can continue to remain invested in the funds, or consider switching to other funds or selling out of the funds if the funds no longer meet their investment objective.
answer: Members whose investments don't meet new standards can seek to reallocate their funds to other compliant funds or request a refund from the fund manager [Document N].
